subject.title: fix(repair): make cluster intake durable and selective

question: Should maintainers approve this guarded production rollout with the documented immediate post-merge intake canary, or require an equivalent pre-merge environment proof first?
rationale: The patch is structurally reviewed and its automated checks pass, but the real Cloudflare queue, GitHub App token, and Actions receipt path can only be confirmed in a deployed environment.

options.title: Approve guarded rollout
options.body: Merge with the existing gates unchanged, then run the bounded post-merge acceptance procedure and treat any failed recovery invariant as a rollback or follow-up trigger.

options.title: Require pre-merge environment proof
options.body: Keep the PR open until maintainers provide a safe environment that can exercise durable append, materialization, and worker dispatch without changing production.

recommendation.title: Approve guarded rollout
recommendation.body: Merge with the existing gates unchanged, then run the bounded post-merge acceptance procedure and treat any failed recovery invariant as a rollback or follow-up trigger.
